lines.meet: Name's Silas, and I notice things for a living. What did I do before? Port work, and ask me again tomorrow, it'll be different port work.
lines.meet_neighbour: Ratchet's yours too, then. I'm over the net-maker's on the middle pier, Silas, and I've already noticed which room's yours.
lines.ask_home: Go on then, where'd you wash up from? I'll tell you mine, and one of us might even be honest.
lines.ask_work: Your hands say one job and your walk says another, so which was it?
lines.answer_home: Antwerp, near the docks. English dad who was mostly at sea, Flemish mum on a cleaner's wage.
lines.answer_work: Port work, and today's version is crane driver. Ask me again tomorrow, it'll be a different crane.
lines.chat_food: Frites from a stand by the Groenplaats, with mayonnaise, and a Bolleke after. Antwerp's whole cuisine, more or less.
lines.chat_sleep: Five years of night shifts, and I'd still sleep till noon if you let me. I'm better at night anyway.
lines.chat_missing: The port at three in the morning, all lit up, cranes going, nobody about. I liked it more than I let on.
lines.chat_here: I came here thinking there'd be no rules, and it turned out the rules are sharper. Took me four months to get it, and it rearranged me a bit.
lines.tease_quiet: I can read most people in a minute, {name}, and you've kept me guessing for weeks. It's very annoying.
lines.tease_talker: You give away everything you're thinking, {name}, and you'd never last a day on the docks.
lines.tease_careful: You check the exits before you sit down, {name}. Takes one to know one.
lines.tease_bold: You walk into a room like nobody's ever robbed you, {name}. Give it time.
lines.tease_any: I've got you figured out, {name}, mostly, about sixty percent. The other forty bothers me.
lines.tease_back: Ha, nice, {name}, you read me better than I thought.
lines.take_it_kindly: Caught fair and square, {name}, and I'm not even going to wriggle.
lines.bristle: Easy, {name}, that's one subject I don't joke about.
lines.apologise: That was cheap of me, sorry. I hide behind jokes, and sometimes they've got teeth.
lines.double_down: I'd say it again, and that's me committing to something, so enjoy it.
lines.needle_quiet: You notice as much as I do, and you never pass it on. That's how docks get robbed.
lines.needle_talker: You'd tell a stranger your bank details if they smiled. Keep something back, would you?
lines.needle_careful: You're checking it a fourth time. It's fine, it was fine the first time.
lines.needle_bold: You walk in like you own the place, and anybody watching knows exactly where to stick the knife.
lines.needle_any: You believe every story anybody tells you. Out here that gets you robbed or worse.
lines.bite_back: I've spotted every ambush before it landed, and you've walked away from all of them, which you'd do well to remember.
lines.hurt: Right, that one found a gap. I'll be on the pier for a bit.
lines.laugh_off: Captains have called me worse while I was searching their holds. You'll have to dig deeper.
lines.confide: {name}, the docks had an arrangement where everybody took a little. I never joined in and I never said a word, and the second part's the one that bothers me.
lines.listen: No jokes, {name}, I promise. Go on, I'm listening properly for once.
lines.look_out: Watch the shadows in there, {name}, and watch me watching them.
lines.accept: Fine, you win, {name}. I'll let somebody look after me for once.
lines.deflect: Barely touched me, {name}, it looks worse than it is.
lines.check_in: Let's have a look, {name}. Where'd they get you, and don't play it down.
lines.blame: Somebody didn't watch their corner in there, and I'm not naming names, but I'm looking at them.
lines.thank: That's one I owe you, and I don't forget who I owe. Thanks.
lines.brush_off: Don't mention it, really. I'd rather nobody saw me being decent.
lines.worry: That was ugly, {name}, sit down. I counted the seconds you were down, and there were too many.
lines.handed_down: So I'm walking around in your gear. Don't worry, I won't sell it.
lines.hand_fine: Have it, I travel light, and it's easier leaving in a hurry.
lines.hand_sulk: Funny how nobody checked with me first. I did notice, for the record.
lines.turn_friendly: I've stopped trying to read you, {name}, and started just enjoying the company.
lines.turn_friends: I'd tell you the true version of anything, {name}, first time of asking.
lines.turn_grating: I can't make us fit, and I'm usually better at hiding it.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still watch your back, because a dead teammate's bad for business, and it's nothing personal.
lines.make_up: Call it even, {name}? I was no better than you in all this.
lines.defend: I was watching, and that's not how it went. Lay off {name}.
lines.friend_left: With {name} off home, I've nobody to talk straight to. I'm out of practice already.
lines.friend_back: There you are, {name}, and I'd noticed you were gone, which surprised me.
lines.common_docks: You watch a crate the way only dock people do. The port teaches you who's lying faster than anywhere.
